summary: In June 2017, one person was arrested in Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu for the penetrative assault on a child. The charges also include house trespass and criminal intimidation. A weapon was used or a threat was made. Police have filed a chargesheet. The accused was convicted and sentenced to 10 years in prison, and later acquitted on appeal. Identifying details are withheld by law (POCSO s.23).
title: Penetrative assault on a child — Cuddalore (2017) — acquitted on appeal
